test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'. **

Even if a evidence was / relevant to the case, it couldn't / be used to determine the reprobate.

options.text: relevant to the case, it couldn't
be used to determine the reprobate.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **'Even if a evidence was'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part** "even if a evidence was" **of the sentence.
 
• **“Evidence”** is an uncountable noun, like **“information.”**
 
• We would say **a piece of evidence, some evidence, no evidence,** etc.
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 

**Correct sentence**:** **__*__**Even if a piece of evidence was**__ relevant to the case, it couldn't be used to determine the reprobate.*
